passes.purpose: identify, decode, extract, normalize, and preserve source data without changing source substance
discover records, fields, edifice, nesting, sections, messages, tables, attachments, and structural boundaries
divide extracted substance into the smallest useful semantically coherent units while retaining parent context
produce deterministic processing representations while preserving exact source representations by reference
detect exact and near duplicate substance without deleting provenance or distinct occurrences
resolve stable identities for source, record, segment, conversation, attachment, and derived projection
attach source, location, extraction method, lineage, parentage, and transformation evidence
identify language, writing system, encoding anomalies, and multilingual boundaries
extract named and recurring entities without treating inferred identity as authority
extract explicit temporal information and distinguish it from inferred chronology
project supported relationships among entities, records, topics, events, and sources
discover semantic topics independently of user classification categories
score data against arbitrary user-defined categories
compare competing category evidence and identify cross-category contamination
use bounded neighboring, conversational, document, and corpus context to refine interpretation
resolve ambiguous classifications where evidence supports resolution and preserve unresolved ambiguity otherwise
calibrate evidence strength, margins, uncertainty, and acceptance thresholds
retain material that does not sufficiently fit a configured category without information loss
project chronological organization from supported timestamps and temporal relationships
discover reusable semantic groupings inside and across categories
derive useful parent-child and collection-subcollection organization without duplicating substance
identify materially conflicting assertions while preserving every source and authority distinction
identify independently repeated or mutually supporting information without converting repetition into truth
identify information not represented in the selected comparison corpus
rank material against a user objective while keeping relevance separate from authority
identify information density and significance using configurable criteria
detect malformed, truncated, empty, noisy, corrupted, or low-information records
project potentially sensitive-data boundaries for downstream policy-aware consumers without destructive redaction
project known authority status and conflicts without creating or promoting authority
verify that every derived object remains traceable to its exact source substance
project reusable nodes and typed relationships suitable for Datrix composition
derive deterministic lookup, search, category, entity, temporal, and provenance indexes
invoke Opus-owned model orchestration only where deterministic methods cannot adequately resolve semantic work
combine deterministic evidence and Opus judgments while preserving their different epistemic status
project user-selected organizational views without moving or duplicating canonical source substance
derive source-grounded summaries with explicit lineage to supporting segments
derive requested facts, concepts, philosophy, decisions, events, rules, quotations, or other user-defined targets
surface overlooked, orphaned, weakly classified, or previously inaccessible useful information
validate projection integrity, required contracts, source reachability, and deterministic rebuildability
emit requested views, datasets, manifests, Datrix-ready structures, and interoperability representations
